summary: Retest of iteration_4 fixes. critical_code_review_comments: client_ip() falls back to request.client.host when XFF has <= TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS entries; fine for this deployment, but if production topology differs (e.g. no Cloudflare hop) TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS must be adjusted or all users would be attributed to a proxy IP.
Welcome/verify emails fail with 502 'Failed to send email' (no email credit) - expected per main agent, logged in background task only.
